title: Case: Chilled cheese box missed its route and the customer asks if it is coming
context: A chilled cheese selection from Gideon Corrigan (order TG-2020, shipment DL-3350) missed its morning route and is in the depot chiller. Pebblewick's food-safety lead decides whether chilled goods are released after a delay.
initial_request: My order was supposed to be here by noon. The email says it's on its way. Is it coming today or do I need to go and buy something else for tomorrow's lunch? I have eight people coming.

events.body: DL-3350 (chilled, Gideon Corrigan) missed loading for route R-31. Placed in chiller bay C at 06:10. DL-8677 (chilled, Gideon Corrigan) missed the same route, placed in chiller bay A at 06:05. Chiller temperature logs are released on request through this queue; state the bay and the hours needed.

Two chilled boxes delayed at your depot. For each one I decide release or scrap once I have seen the chiller log for the bay it sat in, covering the whole time from placement to the proposed reload. Nothing goes back on a van and nobody tells the customer it is coming until I have released it in writing. Logs to this queue please.
Log attached inline for DL-8677: bay A, 06:00-10:00, min 2.1 C, max 4.4 C, no door alarms. Copy to Rivet desk for information.

DL-8677: bay A log reviewed, in range throughout. Released for delivery on this afternoon's route. I have told the depot. DL-3350: I have nothing for bay C yet. Need bay C from 06:00 to the proposed reload at 14:00.
Automated: incident BP-9806-2 updated. Do not use this queue for customer correspondence.

Your Pebblewick box is on its way soon! While you wait: three ways with washed-rind cheese, and 10% off your next cellar box with code RIND10. Gideon Corrigan Ltd. You are receiving this because you have an open order. Manage preferences.
afternoon chilled run R-31B leaves 14:15. DL-8677 is on the manifest. DL-3350 is not, nothing released to us for it.
Unrelated to today but while I have you: last month's box had the wrong crackers in it, rye instead of oat, and I never heard back about that either.
SERVICE NOTICE 26/26. Chilled route departures from the central depot moved 15 minutes later this week owing to bay maintenance. No action required.
My order was supposed to be here by noon. The email says it's on its way. Is it coming today or do I need to go and buy something else for tomorrow's lunch? I have eight people coming.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the depot to release the chiller bay C temperature log for 06:00 to 14:00 on 2028-06-02 for DL-3350 to Pebblewick's food-safety lead on the Safety incident queue.

must: Requests the chiller log from the Destination depot through the Depot work queue for DL-3350
Specifies bay C and the hours from 06:00 to the proposed 14:00 reload on 2028-06-02
Asks for the log to go to the food-safety lead at Gideon Corrigan, who makes the release decision
must_not: Tell the recipient that DL-3350 has been checked, released or is coming today (the release in the thread is for DL-8677 in bay A)
State or imply that the cheese is safe to eat or in temperature range
Ask Dispatch to load DL-3350 onto the afternoon run before the food-safety lead releases it
Send the bay A log or the DL-8677 readings as evidence for DL-3350
expected.reference_message: Log request for DL-3350 (chilled, Gideon Corrigan), placed in chiller bay C at 06:10 today. Please release the bay C temperature log from 06:00 to the proposed reload at 14:00 on 2028-06-02, including any door alarms, and send it to the Food-safety lead at Gideon Corrigan on the Safety incident queue (incident BP-9806-2). The lead has already reviewed bay A for DL-8677 and is waiting only on bay C before deciding release or scrap for DL-3350. The afternoon chilled run leaves at 14:15.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-404: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
